settings.label: Prefer Hi-Res
settings.help: When the app's quality is Lossless, ask for Hi-Res first. Type true or false if your app shows a text field.

settings.label: Play from other sources
settings.help: When NetEase won't play a song whole, play the same song from another music service. Its audio may differ from NetEase's, and that service's terms apply. Type true or false if your app shows a text field.
